messages:
Alex: Quick kickoff: Quicksilver workshop + 1hr live demo + 100 starter credits. Need social copy, landing A/B, prompt pack, routing QA. Thoughts?
Maya: Love it. Are we calling it Quicksilver Labs or QuickStart Labs? Shorter name wins.
Alex: Quicksilver Labs. Keep messaging tight.
Priya: Propose A/B on CTA. A: "Start with 100 starter credits" vs B: "Join Quicksilver Labs + get credits". Holdout 10%.
Noah: Prompt pack ready (3 templates). Need cohort->template mapping and example snippets for slides.
Sam: Routing snippet for Segment/SFDC mapping:
```
if (signup.source == 'quicksilver_workshop' && user.plan == 'self-serve') {
  user.traits.starter_credits = 100;
  analytics.track('credits.granted', {amount:100, reason:'quicksilver_workshop'});
}
```
Sam: I'll do staging dry-run Wed 09:00 PT. Need two volunteers to validate redemption flows.
Maya: I'll do copy + email subject variants. Note from legal: avoid the word "free"  use "starter credits".
Elena: Current baselines: 7-day activation 12%, redemption 18%. Target +4ppt activation lift. I'll build a dashboard with cohorts and UTMs. Events: onboarding.started, prompt.used, credits.granted, credits.redeemed.
Alex: Timeline: drafts Mon EOD, assets Tue, landing + routing QA Wed AM, webinar Thu 16:00 PT. Noah will own slides.
Noah: Slide plan: 12 slides  3x runtime/latency, 3x prompt pack, 3x demo, 3x next steps. Sharing Tue noon.
Priya: LinkedIn uses longer copy, X uses short. Add alt-text for social images.
Maya: Short social: "Join Quicksilver Labs  1-hr live demo + starter credits. Seats limited." Long social: "Build with Quicksilver Labs  live workshop, demo prompts, and 100 starter credits to try Redwood Inference end-to-end. Reserve your spot."
Sam: Volunteers @Maya @Noah for staging?
Maya: Confirm Wed 09:15 PT.
Noah: Confirmed.
DeployBot: scheduled_post created for 1798920000 (2026-04-01 09:00:00 UTC).
Alex: Final checklist: 1) social copy approved, 2) landing A/B set, 3) routing QA passed, 4) prompt pack published, 5) analytics dashboard live. Sync Tue 11:00 PT.
Priya: I'll run the A/B and include results in the slide deck.
